_meta.description: NPC workers with their own mastery levels. Players can hire them to craft items using the worker's mastery instead of their own. Workers are only available at their assigned stations.

name: Hrogir Ironhand
title: Master Smith
description: A gruff dwarf with decades of smithing experience. His hands are scarred from a thousand forging sessions.

name: Elara Moonsilver
title: Arcane Enchantress
description: A silver-haired elf who weaves magic into items with graceful precision.

name: Borin Copperpot
title: Alchemist Extraordinaire
description: A portly halfling whose potions are famous across the realm. His lab always smells of herbs and ozone.

name: Finn Lightfingers
title: Woodcarver
description: A nimble young human with an eye for detail. Can carve anything from a spoon to a longbow.

name: Mara Blacksteel
title: Armorer
description: A stern half-orc woman who forged armor for the city guard. Her plate armor is legendary.

name: Kellen Stormbow
title: Bowyer
description: A ranger who retired from adventuring to craft bows. Each bow is tuned to its owner's hand.

name: Sister Greta
title: Herbalist & Cook
description: A kindly older woman who runs the temple kitchen. Her meals are both delicious and restorative.

name: Veldrin Ashblade
title: Bladesmith
description: An exiled dark elf whose blades are works of art. He imbeds subtle enchantments into the metal itself.

name: Tilda Honeywort
title: Brewmistress
description: A gnome with a passion for fermentation. Her potions taste like fine mead but pack a real punch.

name: Ser Joffrey
title: Weapons Trainer
description: A knight who trains the city watch. He can teach you techniques that take years to learn alone.

name: Morwen Whisperwind
title: Shadow Trainer
description: A lithe woman who seems to appear from nowhere. She teaches the art of moving unseen.

name: Archmage Corvus
title: Grand Sorcerer
description: An ancient archmage whose beard trails on the floor. His magical knowledge is unparalleled.

name: Lydia Fairwind
title: Survival Guide
description: A weathered ranger who knows every trail, berry, and creature in the wild.

name: Captain Alderic
title: Tactician
description: A scarred veteran who has won countless battles through clever strategy rather than brute force.

name: Old Marnie
title: Town Healer
description: A grandmotherly woman who knows every folk remedy and herbal cure. She charges only what you can afford.
